summary: Backend-only regression of POST /api/ai/ipd/{admission_id}/discharge-field after the context-builder enrichment + tightened system prompt. All 11 pytest tests pass (11/11 = 100%) in 43.6s against the public EXPO_BACKEND_URL. Verified: 200 + {field,text:non-empty,model:'claude-sonnet-4-5'} for each of the 6 valid field keys (course_in_hospital, condition_at_discharge, discharge_meds, diet_advice, follow_up_plan, operative_notes) on real admission c972c9c9-8771-495b-a76c-faed56be80f1; operative_notes draft contains all required section labels (DATE/SURGEON/ANAESTHESIA/POSITION/PROCEDURE/CLOSURE/POST-OP ORDERS); diet_advice respects extra_hint (diabetes keywords surfaced); invalid field key returns 400 with 'Unknown field' detail; non-existent admission_id returns 404; unauthenticated requests (missing header AND bogus token) return 401. Response shape {field,text,model} unchanged. New context-builder additions (consent procedure descriptions, anaesthesia, doctor's consent notes, surgery operative_findings/blood_loss/complications/post_op_investigations/surgeon/anaesthesia, admission chief_complaints/examination/allergies/comorbidities) did not break the AI flow.
critical_code_review_comments: ai_clinical.py _build_context_block: All newly-surfaced fields (consent procedure description/anaesthesia/doctor_notes, surgery operative_findings/blood_loss/complications/post_op_investigations/surgeon/anaesthesia, admission chief_complaints/examination/allergies/comorbidities) are guarded with truthy checks and length-capped (e.g. 600/400/320/240 chars) — safe for token budget. Hard cap of 18000 chars on the final context_block is preserved.

Endpoint correctly returns 401 (via require_user) before role-gating, 400 for unknown field BEFORE running _gather_admission_context, and 404 from _gather_admission_context when the admission is absent — error ordering is correct.

Minor: _gather_admission_context resolves clinic_id then queries with it; the seed admission is found because clinic scoping resolves to its own clinic for the owner token. If a clinician's resolved clinic_id mismatches the admission's clinic_id, the user sees 404 (not 403) — acceptable for safety but worth noting.
